name: NumberCove
description: Free private calculators: seller fees, shipping, inventory, options and investing, loans, work and retirement, home projects, energy, health estimates, and unit conversion. All math runs in the browser.

tools.name: Marketplace payout calculator
tools.description: Enter a listing price to compare what you keep after fees on eBay, Poshmark, Vinted, Whatnot, Mercari, Fashionphile, and The RealReal, or enter what you want to make to calculate what to list it for. Choose clothing, handbags, jewelry, watches, sneakers, coins, or cards to load matching fee charts.

tools.name: StubHub and Ticketmaster resale calculator
tools.description: Compare seller net on StubHub, Ticketmaster Resale, and SeatGeek, or back into the list price to hit a target net.

tools.name: Mortgage calculator
tools.description: Monthly principal and interest, taxes, insurance, HOA, PMI, extra principal, and an amortization snapshot.

tools.name: Commercial real estate ROI and APOD calculator
tools.description: Build an Annual Property Operating Data statement and evaluate NOI, cap rate, cash-on-cash return, lender coverage, financing, and a hold-and-resale projection.

tools.name: Options price, Greeks, and P&L calculator
tools.description: Price calls, puts, and spreads of up to 4 legs. Slide the underlying price, target date, and implied volatility to see option value, P&L, Greeks, breakeven, probability of profit, a payoff chart, and a P&L heat map. American (binomial) and European (Black-Scholes) pricing.

tools.name: Covered call and cash-secured put calculator
tools.description: Calculate net premium, breakeven, maximum profit and loss, return if assigned, annualized return, scenario P&L, expiration payoff, and an IV-based estimate of finishing in the money.

tools.name: Expected move calculator
tools.description: Estimate one- and two-standard-deviation price ranges from annualized IV, compare an ATM-straddle move, and measure a target or post-event move in standard deviations.

tools.name: Options roll and wheel strategy calculator
tools.description: Track wheel campaign credits and economic breakeven or compare an option roll's close debit, new credit, strike, expiration, assignment economics, and scenario P&L.

tools.name: Refinance calculator
tools.question: Should I refinance my mortgage?
tools.description: Compare current vs new loan payment, closing costs, and break-even months.

tools.name: Loan amortization calculator
tools.description: Fixed-rate installment payment, extra principal, total interest, and payoff date.

tools.name: Compound interest calculator
tools.description: Future value with compounding frequency and recurring contributions.

tools.name: Tip calculator
tools.description: Tip amount, total, and even split on the full bill or pre-tax amount.

tools.name: BMI calculator
tools.description: US and metric BMI, WHO category, and a healthy-weight range. Screening only.

tools.name: Body-fat estimate
tools.description: U.S. Navy circumference body-fat estimate. Not a clinical measurement.

tools.name: TDEE calculator
tools.description: Mifflin–St Jeor BMR, activity multiplier, cut and gain calorie targets.

tools.name: Paint coverage calculator
tools.description: Gallons of paint from room dimensions or square footage, including coats.

tools.name: Flooring estimator
tools.description: Flooring square footage with waste, box count, and material cost.

tools.name: Concrete volume calculator
tools.description: Slab volume in cubic yards plus 40/60/80 lb bag estimates.

tools.name: Tile estimator
tools.description: Tile count from room size, grout gap, waste, and boxes.

tools.name: Length converter
tools.description: Convert metric and imperial length units using exact SI factors.

tools.name: Weight converter
tools.description: Convert mass units including kilograms, pounds, ounces, and stone.

tools.name: Volume converter
tools.description: Convert liters, US kitchen measures, UK gallons, and cubic units.

tools.name: Temperature converter
tools.description: Convert Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, and Rankine.

tools.name: Area converter
tools.description: Convert square meters, feet, acres, hectares, and square miles.

tools.name: Percentage calculator
tools.description: What is X% of Y, reverse percent, percent change, increase or decrease.

tools.name: Dimensional weight calculator and box optimizer
tools.description: Compare actual weight with UPS daily and retail, FedEx, and USPS dimensional weight using 2026 divisors, find the smallest box that fits, and see which cut drops the billable weight or gets you under the USPS 1 cubic foot line.

tools.name: Storage unit calculator: keep, sell, or rebuy
tools.question: Should I keep my storage unit or sell my stuff?
keywords: is a storage unit worth it
tools.description: Compare storage rent, annual rent increases, insurance, and move-out costs with selling your belongings now and rebuying what you need later, and find the month storage stops making sense.

tools.name: Inventory aging and markdown timing calculator
tools.question: Should I wait for full price or take the offer?
tools.description: For resellers: compare holding out for full price with taking an offer now or liquidating, using monthly sell-through odds, holding cost, price decline, fees, and the cost of tied-up cash. Shows the sell-through rate needed to justify waiting.

tools.name: Max buy price calculator for resellers
tools.description: Work backward from the expected sale price on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Whatnot, Etsy, or Vinted to the maximum buy price that hits your ROI, margin, or dollar-profit target after fees, shipping, supplies, returns, sales tax, and time.

tools.name: 401(k) match and paycheck pacing calculator
tools.question: How much should I put in my 401(k) to get the full match?
tools.description: Find the 401(k) contribution percentage that captures the full employer match and reaches the 2026 limit on the last paycheck, with per-paycheck matching, true-ups, bonuses, catch-up contributions, and vesting.

tools.name: Return-to-office and commute cost calculator
tools.question: Is returning to the office worth it?
tools.description: Add fuel, depreciation, tolls, parking, transit, childcare, meals, clothing, and unpaid commute time to see the monthly and annual cost of returning to the office and the pre-tax raise needed to offset it.

tools.name: Credit card annual fee break-even calculator
tools.question: Is my credit card's annual fee worth it?
tools.description: Decide whether a credit card's annual fee pays for itself by valuing points, cash back, statement credits, lounge visits, and transfer partners at what you'll really use, and compare with a no-fee or downgraded card. Shows the break-even spend and point value.

tools.name: Social Security claiming age and break-even calculator
tools.question: When should I claim Social Security?
tools.description: See your Social Security benefit at every claiming age from 62 to 70 using SSA reduction and delayed-credit rules, the break-even ages between them, and which age delivers the most lifetime benefits to your planning age.

tools.name: Pay off mortgage early or invest calculator
tools.question: Should I pay off my mortgage early or invest?
tools.description: Compare making extra mortgage payments with investing the same money: interest saved, years cut, net worth over time, and the break-even investment return, with optional mortgage interest deduction and tax drag.

tools.name: Extended warranty calculator: buy the plan or self-insure
tools.question: Should I buy the extended warranty?
keywords: is an extended warranty worth it
tools.description: Compare an extended warranty or protection plan with self-insuring: expected repair costs, deductibles, exclusions, and free credit card coverage, plus the break-even chance of a repair.

tools.name: Repair or replace appliance calculator
tools.question: Should I repair or replace my appliance?
tools.description: Decide whether to repair or replace a refrigerator, washer, dryer, dishwasher, range, water heater, furnace, AC, or heat pump using lifespan, repair odds, energy use, and an interest rate.

tools.name: Buy, rent, or hire calculator
tools.question: Should I buy the tool, rent it, or hire someone?
tools.description: Compare the total cost of buying a tool, renting it, or hiring a professional, including materials, your time, the chance of redoing work, resale value, and future projects, and see how many uses make buying worth it.

tools.name: Moving cost calculator: truck vs movers vs container
tools.question: Is it cheaper to rent a truck or hire movers?
keywords: rent a truck or hire movers
tools.description: Compare the full cost of moving with a rental truck, full-service movers, or a portable moving container, including fuel, car trailer, helpers, tips, protection, lodging, storage, and the value of your time.

tools.name: Heat pump vs furnace calculator
tools.question: Will a heat pump save money over my furnace?
keywords: heat pump vs gas furnace cost
is a heat pump worth it
tools.description: Compare a heat pump with a natural gas, propane, heating oil, or electric furnace: yearly heating and cooling cost, installed price, payback, the break-even electricity price, and CO2, adjusted for climate.

tools.name: EV vs gas car calculator: real cost per mile
tools.question: Is an electric car cheaper than gas?
tools.description: Compare an electric vehicle with a gas car: cost per mile by charging location, maintenance, insurance, EV fees, resale, payback of the price premium, break-even gas price, and CO2.

tools.name: Lease vs buy car calculator
tools.question: Should I lease or buy my next car?
keywords: should I lease or buy a car
tools.description: Calculate a car lease payment from MSRP, negotiated price, residual, and money factor, compare it with financing, and see the net cost over the lease term and over the years you would keep the car.

tools.name: Solar panel payback calculator by state
tools.question: Will solar panels pay off for my home?
tools.description: Estimate solar panel payback, 25-year savings, IRR, and cost per kWh using state-average electricity rates and production, your quote, net metering or export credits, and whether waiting for cheaper or better panels pays.
